plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Bachelor of Arts Music (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, Version 2026/01/04. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. The PDF lists both new and old course numbers; the new numbers are used as the seed codes. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 15+15+15+15+15+15+15+15 = 120; all printed semester totals reconcile with the course rows. QUIRKS KEPT VERBATIM: MUAP Applied Major, MUEN Large/Small Ensemble, MUS/APM Music Elective(s), and MUHS Music History Elective are printed with variable course numbers that differ by level/instrument (rendered in the PDF as MUAP 2___1 / MUAP 3___1 style); they are recorded as choice slots with the departmental prefix as code since no single number applies. MUSC 10490/MUSC 30490 Performance Lab is a genuine 0-credit required course (required_zero). Natural Science Elective appears in both Freshman Spring (4 hrs) and Sophomore Spring (4 hrs) exactly as printed. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course. REPEATS DOCUMENTED (allow_repeated_courses): per the official 2026-2027 BA Music degree plan PDF, applied lessons (MUAP), ensembles (MUEN), and music electives (MUS/APM) are sequenced every term with level-appropriate variable numbers, and MUSC 10490 Performance Lab is sequenced every term Freshman Fall through Sophomore Spring with MUSC 30490 Performance Lab every term Junior Fall through Senior Fall.
